photos.c: ABOVE: Andrew Lloyd has provided a great boost to our Middle Distance Squad. He followed up his exciting victory in the Commonwealth 5000m with a string of P.b's including a new Oz record for the 3000m with a 7:45.95 effort which erased the long standing time set by Ron Clarke.

Oliver Foote has had one of his best ever points score for our British and achieved a long held ambition to win the Surrey 5000m title to add to the 10000m wins achieved several years ago. Here he leads a classy Div.1 BAL field with Andrew Lloyd just behind him .
